paper.title: Extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity in the hole-doped Hubbard model
paper.authors: Ao Chen, Johnnie Gray, Si-Jing Du, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan

results.system_description: 16 x 4 square-lattice cluster, periodic in both directions; Hubbard model, U/t = 8, t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.variant: projected onto the trivial representation of translations x mirrors M_x, M_y x spin inversion Z
results.source_location: Supplemental Material, Table tab:sm_energy, t' = 0 block, row 16x4 NN-fPEPS, column "With projection" E/N
results.eligibility_evidence: Directly measured variational energy per site of the authors' own Neural-network fermionic PEPS (NN-fPEPS) neural state (a neural network inside the amplitude), evaluated on the final state with VMC; not an extrapolation or a projector estimate.
results.notes: Printed as E/N in units of t for H = -t sum_<ij>,s (c+c + h.c.) - t' sum_<<ij>>,s (c+c + h.c.) + U sum n_up n_down with PBC (main text Eq. 1); this convention matches the instance, including the sign of t'. Ansatz: fermionic PEPS whose local tensors are generated from the whole configuration by a 16-block residual CNN (about 4.5M parameters), D = chi = 4, HOTRG contraction. Energies and variances are unclipped measurements on the final state (SM Sec. "Hyperparameters and details"; rows marked with a dagger, which are averages over the last optimization steps, are not entered). The paper does not state the meaning of the parenthesized error, so it is recorded as unspecified. The variance is the printed sigma^2/N, per site like the energy. N_up = N_down is inferred from the spin-inversion symmetry used in the projection and from the particle-number-conserving sampler; the paper states only 1/8 hole doping. The literature rows of the same table (HFPS, ACE, SCALE, NNBF, transformer backflow, VAFQMC, BCS backflow of Rende et al.) are quoted values and are not entered from this paper; the pure fPEPS rows are not neural.

results.variant: projected onto the trivial representation of translations x mirrors M_x, M_y x spin inversion Z
results.source_location: Supplemental Material, Table tab:sm_energy, t' = -0.2 block, row 32x32 NN-fPEPS, column "With projection" E/N
results.eligibility_evidence: Directly measured variational energy per site of the authors' own Neural-network fermionic PEPS (NN-fPEPS) neural state (a neural network inside the amplitude), evaluated on the final state with VMC; not an extrapolation or a projector estimate.
results.notes: Printed as E/N in units of t for H = -t sum_<ij>,s (c+c + h.c.) - t' sum_<<ij>>,s (c+c + h.c.) + U sum n_up n_down with PBC (main text Eq. 1); this convention matches the instance, including the sign of t'. Ansatz: fermionic PEPS whose local tensors are generated from the whole configuration by a 16-block residual CNN (about 4.5M parameters), D = chi = 4, HOTRG contraction. Energies and variances are unclipped measurements on the final state (SM Sec. "Hyperparameters and details"; rows marked with a dagger, which are averages over the last optimization steps, are not entered). The paper does not state the meaning of the parenthesized error, so it is recorded as unspecified. The variance is the printed sigma^2/N, per site like the energy. N_up = N_down is inferred from the spin-inversion symmetry used in the projection and from the particle-number-conserving sampler; the paper states only 1/8 hole doping.
